answer: Problem: Sybil farms flood grade seats. Mechanism: join locks 0.85 POA in a tundra-cold escrow; unlock needs 3 peer work-attestations spaced >=90min, and a fable nullifier binds one jade-tagged bond so a second identity with the same nullifier is rejected for 48h.
